add.event: 英格兰银行与卢森堡监管机构命令 BCCI 改用单一会计师
add.evidence: In October 1985, the Bank of England and the Monetary Institute of Luxembourg (Luxembourg's bank regulator) ordered BCCI to change to a single accountant

add.event: 普华审计发现 BCCI 有数亿美元无法解释的损失
add.evidence: In 1990, a Price Waterhouse audit of BCCI revealed an unaccountable loss of hundreds of millions of dollars.

add.event: 七国海关与银行监管机构突击查封 BCCI 分支机构记录
add.evidence: BCCI became the focus of a massive regulatory battle in 1991, and, on 5 July of that year, customs and bank regulators in seven countries raided and locked down records of its branch offices

add.event: 清算人对审计师的诉讼以1.75亿美元和解
add.evidence: which was settled for $175 million in 1998.
